description.value: J & L Drive-In is a classic burger drive-in located in Port Alberni on Vancouver Island, serving quick meals in the traditional curbside style. The no-smoking policy (confirmed via OSM) makes it a comfortable roadside stop for cyclists moving through the Alberni Valley. Drive-in format means quick service without a long sit-down commitment.
